messages:
james_sales: Heads up — during this morning's POC demo (acme corp) traffic spike caused intermittent 5xxs. Demo stalled for ~90s. Can eng triage? Logs attached in thread.

maria_engineer: Thanks — can you paste the request ids and approximate time? also was this hosted or dedicated for the POC?

james_sales: hosted. request ids: req=3f9a, req=4b2c, timeframe ~2026-03-19 14:02-14:04 UTC. Customer saw 502 then 503. Also some 429s right before.

ashok_oncall: Looking. Alert from autoscaler: 'scaling lag > 30s' at 14:01:55. Queue depth spiked to 720. Pod pool exhausted, fallback to lower tier started. Sharing logs.

ashok_oncall: ```[14:01:56] worker-7 ERROR: accept_connection: backpressure triggered, queue_size=720
[14:02:00] autoscaler INFO: scaling to 10 -> 12 (initiated)
[14:02:30] worker-3 WARN: became unresponsive, 502 returned
[14:02:50] router INFO: returning 503 to client due to no healthy backends
```

maria_engineer: Looks like autoscaler did react but provisioning delay > 30s. This is the POC hosted default autoscale policy (min=2,max=12, scale_cooldown=20s). We saw slow GPU instance allocation from cloud region eu-west-1. Can we failover to burstpool?

ashok_oncall: We can enable burst capacity for the POC: toggle 'allow-burst=true' — temporary fix. Also we can tune batching windows to reduce queue depth.

james_sales: What's the cost delta if we enable burst? customer asked about potential surge charges.

maria_engineer: Rough estimate for this demo: extra ~$120/hr if burst to 4 gpus. If we enable for 5 minutes it's negligible. I'll propose enabling for the remaining demos and then revert.

charlie_sec: Any PCI/PII implications for routing to burst pool? Also need approval for customer-facing change.

maria_engineer: No data plane change; still same model, same VPC. I'll add audit log entry and ping legal. @charlie_sec please ACK.

support_bot: Incident note created — INC-2026-0319-22. Auto-run: collect-profile, collect-kv-cache-stats.

james_sales: OK pls enable burst for acme POC and confirm when done. Need a short blurb to send the customer.

ashok_oncall: Done — burst enabled at 14:06 UTC. Response stabilized, 5xxs dropped. Sending blurb:
"We observed a short-lived surge that exhausted the POC burstless pool; we enabled temporary burst capacity which restored service. We'll follow up with a config to prevent recurrence."

james_sales: perfect, sending to customer now. Thank you :thumbsup:
